headline: BepiColombo Reaches Mercury Orbit After Short Thruster Burn
deck: A public operations update confirmed capture and said the burn ended short after a software issue; the published schedule still lists spacecraft separation for 9–10 December.
body: A public operations update said BepiColombo had been captured into orbit around Mercury. [E1]
The update said the thruster burn during the manoeuvre was shorter than planned following a software issue. [E2]
ESA’s mission update lists separation of the MPO and Mio spacecraft for 9–10 December and the start of the science phase in April 2027. [E3]
